column1: # Cut-pool filtering (CoinCutPool-based, generalized from CglBKClique's own
# clique-cut filtering to Gomory/MixedIntegerRounding2/Twomir/Probing) sweep
# configs for cutfilter-sweep. See CbcCutPoolFilter.cpp for the env vars.
# Format: one config per line, tab-separated
#   <name>\t<comma-separated overrides, or - for none>
# Each override token is either KEY=VAL (exported as an env var) or
# CLI:<arg> (appended as an extra cbc command-line argument).
# "today" must always be present -- it is the baseline every other config
# is compared against (shipped defaults: this generic filter is compiled in
# but effectively off for Gomory/MIR2/Twomir/Probing since
# the cutFilterMinCandidates/cutFilterMinCols gates were chosen conservatively;
# CglBKClique's own clique-cut filtering is unaffected either way).
# Stage 1 -- does turning the filter on at all help, and at what minimum
# candidate-count gate? (mirrors CglBKClique's own MIN_CANDIDATES=20 default,
# empirically the point below which filtering essentially never fires).
today
filter_always
filter_min5
filter_min20
filter_min50
filter_smallcols100
# Stage 2 -- parallelism/orthogonality secondary filter on top of the
# best-fitness-per-column contest (parity with CglBKClique's
# CBC_CLIQUE_POOL_MAX_PARALLELISM sweep, which found no net win there --
# checking whether the other 4 generators behave differently).
filter_par09
filter_par07
filter_par05
# Stage 3 -- reinvest time saved by filtering into more cut-generation
# rounds at root (default passCuts=100 for <5000 cols/20 otherwise --
# see CbcParameters.cpp CUTPASS setup).
filter_reinvest200
